correctness.rationale: Finite Esakia duality reduces every embedded Heyting subalgebra to a surjective bounded-morphism kernel. The upper-cone equation forces any mixed block to absorb the full upper layer; conversely each permitted partition defines a bounded quotient. The two disjoint kernel families give the displayed Stirling exponents and Bell total; allowed pairwise merges prove the grading. An independent standard-library program exhaustively verifies all nine parameter pairs 1≤a,b≤3, all 106 subalgebras, and 2,142 kernel-inclusion comparisons, while the proof covers all positive integers.

value.rationale: The family is the canonical complete two-level finite intuitionistic Kripke frame. Its full embedded Heyting-subalgebra lattice governs all implication-closed subsemantics, and distinguishing two-level quotients from one-top quotients yields a nontrivial two-parameter size distribution, rank structure and maximal-subalgebra boundary. Exact enumeration across arbitrary layer sizes is motivated independently of small-case computation; this is more than a renamed Bell-number identity.
